Any read-path gate on user-prompt-side work (lessons, told, file conflicts, drive line) needs `--session <registered id>`, e.g. `npm run bench:read-paths -- ... --fixture repo --session <an id with session_started in the bound record>`. On the repo fixture bench/read-paths.mjs defaults to `bench-read-paths`, which is unregistered, so user-prompt returns before any per-session work and the gate passes having measured nothing (found 2026-09-23 on the 2.11 D18: the unregistered run read +1.1%, the registered one -13.3%). i1000-10mb registers its own session, so it is unaffected.
